explanation: f'(x)=-3x^2+6x-3=-3(x-1)^2. It is negative on both sides of the only stationary point, x=1, so the derivative does not change sign. Therefore the function has no local extrema.

answers.correct_value: The function $f(x)$ has no local extrema
answers.wrong_value: There is a local maximum at $x=1$
